# Joey Fraser

> Joey Fraser is the Head of Risk Operations at Whim, a hardware-subscription platform powering recurring-revenue programs for global technology brands. Based in San Francisco.

Joey leads payment and asset recovery strategy at Whim (formerly Fragile). His background spans risk operations, recovery analytics, and consumer-finance operations at scale. He occasionally writes about operations, risk, and the infrastructure that makes hardware subscriptions work.
